help.tag: A tag classifies the event (e.g. «Meeting», «Camp»). Protocol blocks and submissions filter by it; a filter matches every tag that contains the search text. Renaming changes the tag on all events and in submissions.
help.cycles: By default an event belongs to the cycle its date falls into. A manual assignment is kept even if the date changes and controls in which cycle filters (protocols, submissions, photo albums) the event appears.
help.currentCycle: By default the list only shows events of the current cycle (e.g. the running club year). With this switch, events of earlier and later cycles appear too.
help.csvImport: Start date and title are required. hocX does not check for duplicates: importing a file twice creates the events twice. Imported events are assigned to their cycle by date.
help.calendarDocsLink: Subscribe to events in your own calendar
help.roles: Assign people to the event's roles. The «Special» fields are free to use; they can be renamed or hidden in the tenant settings.
